ASKS.text: const ASKS=/^(describe|explain|provide|list|detail|outline|how|what|which|where|when|who|confirm|identify|indicate|state|include|demonstrate|summari[sz]e|specify|propose|define|discuss|document|share|present|submit|do you|does your|can you|will you|are you|have you|is your|please)\b/i;

INSTRUCTION.text: const INSTRUCTION=/\b(respond|reply|answer)\b.*\b(each|every|all)\b.*\b(question|item|section)s?\b|in the order (given|listed|presented|shown)|^instructions?\b|^submit\b|^include a signed|\bdeadline\b|^(responses?|proposals?) (are |is )?due\b|^keep each answer/i;

asks_gate.text: const asks=/\?/.test(body)||body.replace(/^[\u2022\-\u2013*]\s*/,'').split(/(?<=[.!])\s+/).some(sentence=>ASKS.test(sentence));   // a request verb may open the second sentence: 'Our team runs X. Describe how...'
